Panzvimbo yakati sandara isina kukwazisana, simba rehorizontal $F = 10\text{ N}$ rinoshanda pachinhu chine huremu $m = 2\text{ kg}$ panhambwe ye $4\text{ m}$. Ndeipi chirevo chinotsanangura basa $W$ nekukasira $a$ zvakanaka?
20261118-physics-g03.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Ongororo yeFizikisi] Dambudziko rinoshandisa misimboti ye Chiedza nemimvuri. Panzvimbo yakati sandara isina kukwazisana, simba rehorizontal $F = 10\text{ N}$ rinoshanda pachinhu chine huremu $m = 2\text{ kg}$ panhambwe ye $4\text{ m}$. Danho 2: Basa rakaitwa ndi $W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Danho 3: Saka kukasira ndi $5\text{ m/s}^2$ uye basa ndi $40\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-g03-1.material: [E3 Ongororo yeFizikisi (Pamberi)] Ongororo yekufamba kwekudonha pachena kune chekuita ne Chiedza nemimvuri. Chinhu chinodonhedzwa kubva pakuzorora pasina mweya pasi pegiravhiti $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Chii chinonzi velocity $v$ nenhambwe $h$ yakadonha mushure me $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g03-1.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Ongororo yeFizikisi (Pamberi)] Ongororo yekufamba kwekudonha pachena kune chekuita ne Chiedza nemimvuri. Chinhu chinodonhedzwa kubva pakuzorora pasina mweya pasi pegiravhiti $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Chii chinonzi velocity $v$ nenhambwe $h$ yakadonha mushure me $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g03-1.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Velocity $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Danho 2: Nhambwe $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Danho 3: Saka $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ uye $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
